nodes.action: Capture bounded question, exact candidate, environment, accepted baseline, and expected behavior if known.
Determine whether the expected result is grounded strongly enough for a defect/regression claim.
Exercise the smallest faithful path on the relevant interface.
Run negative/control or alternate-environment checks that can separate product, harness, and environment causes.
Map boundary values, state transitions, timing, retries, conflicting inputs, or other conditions that define the behavior.
Create/update a bounded regression only after the protected expectation is grounded.
Assign supported evidence labels and write limitations/non-claims.
Send unresolved product decisions or cross-role failures to the owning profession with exact evidence.
Publish QA evidence packet scoped to the exact candidate and environment.
Return HOLD/BLOCKED/NOT_TESTED rather than inventing missing evidence or authority.

edges.when: expectation is grounded or discovery-only observation is sufficient
expected behavior requires another profession's decision
material expectation is unknown and no owner/evidence surface is available
behavior reproduced or suspicious harness/environment behavior appears
exact requested execution surface is unavailable and substitution would mislead
product behavior remains the supported cause
an accepted invariant or known failure is grounded
observation is useful but no regression is justified
fixture and controls have been run
claim is supported and boundaries are explicit
QA packet is complete even though another profession owns the next decision
